اصطلقت (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَقْتُ (iṣṭalaqtu) /isˤ.tˤa.laq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اِصْطَلَقْتَ (iṣṭalaqta) /isˤ.tˤa.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اِصْطَلَقْتِ (iṣṭalaqti) /isˤ.tˤa.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اِصْطَلَقَتْ (iṣṭalaqat) /isˤ.tˤa.la.qat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
